lines.en: It doesn’t take long to find Otoha once I make my way over to the park again.
In fact, she winds up spotting me first and trots over without me even having to ask.
This is good.
If she keeps growing at this rate, she might just wind up walking over to my house in the morning and, eventually, I won’t need to leave at all.
: I’ll leave a key for you under the doormat.
: Key? What?
: What are you talking about?
: Just the bright future the two of us have together...
: Oh. Uhh, okay. Whatever floats your boat.
: No guitar today either?
: Not really any point until it gets a little warmer.
: The other day would have been fine, but it’s back to being chilly again and I don’t want to wind up botching any of my songs when I’m still not known around here.
: Just buy hand warmers or something. Problem solved.
: Sure, that’ll solve my finger stiffness...but it’s not like everybody will come flocking to the park as soon as they hear that some random girl bought handwarmers.
: There’s more than just one problem, Sensei.
: Why not play indoors then?
: What, you mean at that gazebo thing over there? That’s not really going to do much.
: I meant something more like an actual business. Like some local venue or a-
: Cafe!
: Holy shit! Yeah! That place where Rin works would be great to play at!
: People actually go there in the morning and there’s like...tons of space!
: Also, the manager there really has a thing for [teenage]girls. So you’re basically already locked in.
: You know, maybe we should think of other places just in case. The cafe is cool and all, but-
: Don’t worry. She’s still running a business, so it’s not like she’ll make a move on you mid-set or anything.
: Is that supposed to make me more comfortable?...
: Hey. As a female musician, and a rather attractive one, might I add-
: You really didn’t have to add that.
: You should start getting used to being the center of attention. It’s only going to happen more once you start getting popular.
: How do you think Niki feels? She’s on actual billboards and she loves the attention.
: Sure, yeah. But don’t you feel a little weird being her ex and knowing that there are a bunch of dudes out there who want to get it on with her?
: Not really. Because I know I’m the only one who has.
: Probably.
: If you’re worried about her hooking up with anybody else, I know for a fact that she hasn’t.
: She’s really only ever talked about one guy and...that guy somehow wound up being you.
: That’s cool. But I meant more that I haven’t exactly confirmed if I have had sex with her yet.
: How...can you not know that?
: Wait, she didn’t like...do stuff to you in your sleep or something...did she?
: She very well may have done just that, Otoha...
: Oh my God. That’s so messed up.
: She’s kind of controlling though, so I guess I could see that.
Sorry, Niki. I have tarnished your name once again.
Unless you actually did assault me in my sleep.
If that’s the case-
Nice.
: But anyway, you should probably get used to people wanting to “get it on” with you.
: That’s a little easier said than done, man...
: Well, if you’d like...I could help loosen you up a-
: Oh, look. Is that a police officer behind you?
: I could help you learn to deal with any insecurities that may have led to your apparent disdain for unwarranted, romantically-focused attention from others.
: Nah. I’m good.
: I’ll take my allowance now, though. I’m still waiting on that 1,000 yen.
: Who are you, my [niece]?
: Hmm...maybe more of a cool big sister.
: I guess little sister would also work given our current dynamic, though.
: But we should probably stop talking about this before Nodoka shows up out of nowhere and tries to write some doujin about us.
: Since you won't be giving any generous contributions to my music fund, do you want to at least take a trip to the cafe with me?
: It's not like I have anything else going for me this morning since I don't have lessons.
: Plus, it will probably be really funny to see Rin’s reaction to the two of us showing up together.
: I feel like she will either love it or absolutely hate it.
: I’m leaning toward the former. I think she’ll be stoked to know that two of her confirmed “favorite people” have started hanging out.
: Just wait until she learns we’re family now as well.
: Come on, big bro! Let’s go torment our favorite barista!
Otoha and I set off toward the cafe and I feel slightly bad for Molly in not giving her the title of my favorite barista.
But, to be fair, Molly is very bad at her job.
I can’t even remember if she’s ever actually sold me anything.
At least Rin tries.
Tries a little too hard sometimes, sure. But she tries.
A short while later, Otoha and I wind up outside the cafe and exchange one final look of platonic sibling love before walking in and ruining (Or making) Rin’s day.
: Yo! Morning.
: One copyrighted frozen beverage please.
: Well I definitely don’t like this.
: It’s cool. We’re family now.
: Does Nodoka know?
: I demand customer service.
: Not yet. We’re trying to keep it a secret from her.
: You want in as well?
: Yes. Immediately.
: Tell me what I must do.
: Nothing that serious...
: Just...you know. Maybe letting me play here sometime?
: It’s a little too cold out to be playing in the park right now, and Sensei came up with the idea of maybe playing in the cafe.
: If that’s cool, I mean. I totally understand if it’s not.
: Yo! Morning.
: One copyrighted frozen beverage please.
: Are you fucking kidding me?
: Was the first time not enough?
: You’re really going to do this again?
: Wait, what? What’s going on?
: Is everything okay? We didn’t come here to mess with you or anything.
: Maybe you didn’t.
: It wouldn’t be the first time Sensei decided to start getting close to someone I...am friends with, though.
: Yeah. This probably wasn’t a good idea after all.
: Well...I’m really sorry if we upset you...
: But we’re really just here to ask if it would be okay for me to...maybe play in the cafe sometime.
: It’s a little too cold out to be playing in the park right now, and Sensei came up with the idea of maybe playing here.
: If that’s cool, I mean. I totally understand if it’s not.
: Oh my God, yeah! Totally!
: I mean, it’s not really up to me. But my manager like, really has a thing for [teenage]girls. So you’re basically already locked in.
: Hell yeah! Mission complete!
: Wait, you know about that?
: Dude, why else would she hire exclusively cute girls? We work in a cafe, not a topless bar.
: I’m pretty sure Haruka thinks she’s managed to hide it from you.
: Then she should probably stop “accidentally” sending pictures of her in her underwear to our group chat and saying they were meant for someone else.
: You know, maybe we should think of other places just in case. The cafe is cool and all, but-
: Don’t you dare chicken out after coming this far.
: Think of what Niki would do.
: Is like...everyone on this side of town weird, or?...
: If you think this is bad, you should take a visit to the old district.
: Uhh...I’m good. That place kinda creeps me out.
: I’ll try talking to Haruka about it. I’m sure she’ll say it’s fine, but...Hey, you never really know.
: Do you guys need anything? I’m in charge today, so I can give you extra shots for free or something.
: Two “Rin Specials” please.
: You got it, Sensei.
: Go sit down. I’ll bring over something crazy in just a minute.
: What did you just order me?
: Don’t worry about it.
: But...I’m lactose intolerant.
Otoha and I make our way to a table only slightly touched by the sun and take our respective places at opposite ends.
Rin shows up a few moments later with two different drinks and sets one in front of each of us before rushing back to the counter to help another customer...
: So, I might as well get it out of the way now and say thanks for coming up with this idea.
: Don’t thank me until it’s at least been approved.
: But you guys said it yourself, I’m basically locked in.
: Sure. But what if Haruka thinks you’re so attractive that she won’t be able to contain herself around you?
: That could affect business.
: Well?
: Let’s talk about something else.
: Sure. Let’s talk about Rin instead.
: Welp, guess the chance for a normal conversation topic is off the table.
: How are things going for the two of you now that you don’t live far enough apart to come up with excuses for not hanging out with her?
: Wait, what? What are you talking about?
: Weren’t the two of you supposed to go on a trip to some arcade in your neck of the woods a while back?
: I wound up going in your place.
: Yeah, but that was because my parents wouldn’t let me go. It had nothing to do with me trying to get out of it.
: I thought it sounded really fun and we’ve already made new plans to go there together.
: Oh, really? I didn’t hear about that.
: Yeah. I was never trying to avoid her or anything if that’s what you were thinking.
: Well, that’s good.
: She didn’t really let it show, but she was pretty upset that day.
: Oh come on...I like, just stopped feeling bad about that...
: Besides...didn’t getting to go in my place kind of like...work out for you or whatever?
: What do you mean?
: I mean that like...you guys kissed or something, right?
Rin told her that?
Why?
I figured she’d be worried about that ruining her chances with Otoha.
Maybe she just...doesn’t want to hide anything from her?...
I don’t know.
: Yeah. We did.
: Yeah. So like...sorry if it seems like I’m trying to take your place or something. Even if that was only a one time thing.
: I don’t think you’re trying to take my place.
: Hell, I don’t even fully understand what my “place” with Rin is.
: I just wasn’t sure what to think about how you two were doing specifically now that you’re seeing each other a lot more.
: More or less the same as we were before.
: Just now I don’t have to worry about the pressure of being her first kiss if we do wind up becoming anything more than what we are now.
: Wait, so you’re okay with what happened between us? There’s no lingering resentment or anything?
: Why would I resent anything about two people who like each other kissing for a few minutes?
: Things like that happen.
: It’s not like me and her are dating.
: Like, if I made out with Nodoka, I’m sure Rin wouldn’t be upset at all.
: I don't think that’s true. She likes you a lot.
: She likes you a lot, too.
: It’s like she’s going through some...intense war inside of her head where you and me are duking it out for the upper hand.
: Just neither one of us is actually fighting and it’s all on her.
: Pretty good material for a song, now that I think about it.
: Stop being so mature and cool or I’m going to start liking you too.
: But you’re my brother. What would our parents think?
: Haven’t I been telling you this whole time that they don’t matter anymore?
: All that matters is us, my dearest Otoha.
: Okay. I’m uncomfortable now.
: Let’s just talk about music or something instead...
: There’s no need to feel bad. She still really likes you.
: The second you texted her that night, she completely stopped paying attention to me.
: And I don’t blame her after how I’ve treated her feelings in the past.
: If you’ve messed with her feelings in the past, why do you seem so worried about them now?
: Because I’m naturally a horrible person and you’re not.
: Rin still has faith in you. So if you wind up screwing her over as well, she’s probably just doomed to romantic misfortune for the rest of eternity.
: That’s putting way too much pressure on me, Sensei. That’s not fair.
: Rin’s happiness shouldn’t be entirely dependent on either one of us reciprocating her feelings.
: I don’t think you’re a bad guy. I just think you might do bad things every once in a while.
: I’m no different.
: If someone’s feelings get hurt as the result of my actions, like they did with Rin and the arcade trip, I’m obviously going to be upset.
: But I’m not going to give up on everything I want just to make sure they don’t get upset anymore.
: I have no idea how I feel about Rin right now. And there’s a good chance I won’t for a while. I just...
: I have no idea.
: Everything is all so new to me all of a sudden.
: So just let me kinda...take it all in for a little while, okay?
: Yeah. Sure. The way I worded that was pretty bad anyway.
: I just meant there’s no need to get down about upsetting her since she still thinks you’re the coolest girl she’s ever met.
: That really seems to be a recurring theme these days, huh?
: Why does everyone think I’m so cool? Does playing guitar and singing really help that much?
: I don’t know. I still think it’s the rings.
: Bring up the rings one more time and I’m cutting my fingers off.
Otoha and I wind up talking until an orange glow consumes Kumon-mi and daytime begins to exit stage left.
The cafe stays busy throughout the morning, so Rin never gets a chance to spend any time with us.
I’m a little surprised that she was able to prioritize work over hanging out, though.
But I guess she might be trying to prove herself or something since Haruka was confident enough to leave the cafe in her hands for the day.
Either that or she’s just starting to realize that Otoha needs her space to thrive.
I don’t know if I’d go as far as saying she’s truly “out of the cage” yet-
But Otoha's cage is extremely large.
So I’m sure she still has plenty of room to fly and just...hasn’t found the door yet.
Otoha’s affection has increased to [otoha_love]!
